title: chionohebe pulvinaris
intro: Chionohebe pulvinaris, commonly known as the "dwarf alpine hebe", is a species of flowering plant in the hebe family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chionohebe pulvinaris include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chionohebe pulvinaris include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
